title: `pending` reports identity changes
goal: `pendingCases` and `gauntlet pending` take the intended identity and name why a covered case must rerun
acceptance: Options and CLI flags for model digest, runtime identity, scenario and source key; an option left unset does not constrain
New reasons model-changed, runtime-changed, scenario-changed, source-changed, checked after new/changed/other-profile; schema 1 entries are pending under any constrained field
System cases are constrained by source key and scenario, not by model fields
validation: Fixtures for each reason, unconstrained queries, schema 1 entries and the CLI exit codes 0/1/2; npm test
escalation: A field that could carry private content is an owner decision

effort.basis: Released in v0.7.0 after PR #37 (CI 43061373995) and review-fix PR #38 (main CI 43062377867) passed, with independent review; initial estimate 0.5 focused day retained in Git.

privacy: Metadata only: identities, hashes, dates; no outputs, prompts, paths or credentials.
